context_text: The rate of biodiesel production using immobilized lipase may not be governed solely by the reaction of substrates at the interface of the enzyme. The substrate diffusion from the bulk of the ceramic bead may play a significant role, and the limited transport rate may lead to a concentration difference across a stagnant film surrounding the ceramic bead. In this situation, the rate of the drop in substrate and alcohol concentrations in the bulk can be expressed by Eqs. (4) and (5), respectively.
